title: Like Water — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Like Water's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the second light round (2026-11-17): one small thing beside one sentence. Made as if it were the only page: one maker who read the page whole, one challenger who was given nothing of the maker's reasoning, one remake, and a second verdict by the same challenger. Made in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11-2/pieces/Like Water/, where the script, the job and its provenance stay; placed here by the Concierge, with what made it copied from that provenance and not guessed. Loudon approved the line it was made from ("Yes, make them", 2026-11-17, relayed by the working session) and has not seen or heard the finished piece. The section is a proposal until he approves it.

verdicts.file: Like Water — rich — one rule, two grounds.png
verdicts.why: Keep, with three word fixes before placing; picture and script unchanged. Every number recomputed by an independent descent and matching. The caption said the code "never reads the rock", but it reads heights and the heights include the mound; the honest line did not own that the rule itself is a choice, or that the frame ends before the two streams rejoin.

remade.file: Like Water — rich — one rule, two grounds.png
remade.what: Words, and small things in the picture: the caption now says "never names the rock" and ends on the page's own "One nature, manifesting differently depending on context"; two honest lines added (the rule is a choice; where the frame ends) and a third, that the rock reaches the rule only as heights; the footer inside the picture removed; "downhill" set larger.
remade.by: the Like Water maker, the same maker
remade.second_verdict: keep: Checked against the files, not the maker's report. Constants unchanged and every value in the new check file matches an independent recount. On the page "one nature" is self-coherence across six moral domains, and a downhill rule is only a physical image of it; not counted as overclaiming. Still unowned and trivial: about 5% vertical squash in each panel.

pieces.title: One rule, two grounds
pieces.caption: The detour is not a second rule. Each drop does one thing, step downhill, and the code that moves it never names the rock; put a rise in the ground and the same rule bends around it. One nature, manifesting differently depending on context.
pieces.near: the detour around the rock is simply the form that downwardness takes here
